tests.name: V2 PTS reference evaluator correctness
tests.description: Verify that V2 frame_pts_seconds values map correctly to the actual displayed frame for each dive
tests.method: Compare V2 PTS annotation frame index to ffprobe-reported PTS for that frame; tolerance 1/2 frame duration
tests.evidence: BASELINE_A_V2_REFERENCE_REEVALUATION.json verified during V2 repair phase

tests.name: INTERNAL_EVAL label firewall
tests.description: Verify that no INTERNAL_EVAL localization annotation was used for method development decisions
tests.method: Check git log: INTERNAL_EVAL labels created only after all DEVELOPMENT-based decisions (phases A-L) were committed
tests.authority: LOCALIZATION_ANNOTATIONS_V1_FREEZE.json frozen_at timestamp vs INTERNAL_EVAL annotation timestamps
tests.evidence: INTERNAL_EVAL labels written after DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN method freeze; localization server enforces split-level access tokens

tests.name: Localization annotation freeze integrity
tests.description: Verify SHA256 of all annotation files matches the freeze manifest
tests.method: For each file in LOCALIZATION_ANNOTATIONS_V1_FREEZE.json, compute SHA256 and compare to stored hash

tests.name: Frozen detector weights integrity
tests.description: Verify SHA256 of yolov8n.pt matches frozen detector manifest

tests.name: Human timestamp immutability
tests.description: Verify that human annotation timestamps were not modified in V2 repair
tests.method: For each DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN and INTERNAL_EVAL annotation, compare V1 timestamp_seconds to V2 YAML timestamp_seconds; they must be equal
tests.authority: Maintainer authorization: preserve timestamps in V2 repair
